item.summary: New user navigation study: timeline discoverability
item.description:
> **Directions:** Complete the Background & Context sections and relevant data fields **BEFORE** talking with your UX Researcher. Follow the checklist below for more details. > > > ## ✅ Results > > > > Once research is complete: What decision are you making and why? Try to keep it to 2-3 sentences max. > > # 📋 Background & Context > > | | | > | --- | --- | > | ⏱️ History | Support sees a steady trickle of 'where is my project plan?' tickets in each account's first week. Product wants to move the timeline entry point into the left navigation; design believes new users look in the header toolbar first. Leadership decides at the January planning review with no evidence in hand. | > | 🎯 Key Decision | Do we ship the left-navigation timeline entry or invest in a guided tour? Owner: Product Leadership, January planning review. | > | ❗ Assumptions & Hypotheses | **Hypotheses**
1. **H1.** First-week users look for planning features in the header toolbar before the left navigation.
2. **H2.** New project managers who find the timeline in their first session build a plan in that session.
**Assumptions**
1. **A1.** First-week users want to build a plan during their first session. | > >
> 📦 Resources > > - Add links to relevant docs, decks, prior research, customer artifacts. Use Drive / Confluence / Jira URLs that are at least viewable by the team. > >
> > # ❓ Research Questions > > 1. Where do first-week users look for the timeline when they want to plan? > 2. What does a first-session planning attempt look like for a new project manager? > 3. Tertiary research question > > # 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Recruitment Strategy > > | | | > | --- | --- | > | Target Sample Size | 5 internal participants | > | Persona / Customer | New project manager in their first week on a trial account | > | Length of Session / Survey | 30 minutes | > | Link to Artifact(s) | Link to script / survey / discussion guide once written | > >
> 👥 Recruitment Roster > > | Name | Title | Company | Industry | ARR | Contact | Status | Reason | > | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | > | | | | | | | | | > >
> >
> ✏️ Checklist > > - [ ] Scope and prioritize: set UXR Support Level and Assignee with the [prioritization calculator](https://example.com/research-calculator). > - [ ] Draft the study: write Research Questions, Recruitment Strategy, and the script or survey using the [templates folder](https://example.com/templates). > - [ ] Review and recruit: get it reviewed, then recruit and collect data. > - [ ] Synthesize and report: summarize, write the report, fill Results, move to Done. > - [ ] Manage this ticket with the [plugin commands](https://github.com/moliver28/oliver-tree-ai-marketplace). > >

comments.author: Riley Chen
comments.body: Support ticket volume for 'timeline' in week one is stable at about a dozen per week. :eyes:

comments.author: Sam Okafor
